-- Conditions are taken from the claim lines that carry a diagnosis.
-- Mapping:
--   patient_id           <- "Patient account number"
--   encounter_id         <- "Medical record number" (encounter identifier; the claim id is a different key)
--   condition_code       <- "Diagnosis code"

--   condition_start_date <- "Claim service start date"
-- The export has no resolution date, so condition_stop_date is NULL.
-- Claim lines that repeat the same diagnosis within an encounter are collapsed to one row.
with src as (

    select
        try_cast(nullif(trim("Claim service start date"), '') as date) as condition_start_date,
        cast(null as date) as condition_stop_date,
        lower(trim("Patient account number")) as patient_id,
        lower(trim("Medical record number")) as encounter_id,
        trim("Diagnosis code") as condition_code,
        trim("Diagnosis description") as condition_description
    from {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
    where nullif(trim("Diagnosis code"), '') is not null

),

dedup as (

    select
        *,
        row_number() over (
            partition by patient_id, encounter_id, condition_code
            order by condition_start_date, condition_description
        ) as rn
    from src

)

select
    cast(condition_start_date as date) as condition_start_date,
    cast(condition_stop_date as date) as condition_stop_date,
    cast(patient_id as varchar) as patient_id,
    cast(encounter_id as varchar) as encounter_id,
    cast(condition_code as varchar) as condition_code,
    cast(condition_description as varchar) as condition_description
from dedup
where rn = 1

        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].text')

        json_extract_string(i.value, '$.system') AS id_system,
        json_extract_string(i.value, '$.type.coding[0].code') AS id_code,
        json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value') AS id_value
    FROM raw r,
    json_array_elements(json_extract(r.resource, '$.identifier')) AS i

agg_ids AS (
    SELECT
        patient_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN id_system = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/us-ssn' AND id_code = 'SS' THEN id_value END) AS ssn,
        MAX(CASE WHEN id_code = 'DL' THEN id_value END) AS drivers_license_number,
        MAX(CASE WHEN id_code = 'PPN' THEN id_value END) AS passport_number
    FROM identifiers
    GROUP BY patient_id
),

extracted AS (
    SELECT
        r.patient_id,

        -- birth / death dates
        CAST(json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.birthDate') AS DATE) AS birth_date,
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') IS NOT NULL
                THEN split_part(json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.deceasedDateTime'), 'T', 1)
                ELSE NULL
            END AS DATE
        ) AS death_date,

        -- identifiers
        ids.ssn,
        ids.drivers_license_number,
        ids.passport_number,

        json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.name[0].family')                  AS patient_last_name,
        json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.name[0].suffix[0]')               AS patient_suffix,

        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS procedure_code,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')

        -- first reason reference (may be NULL)
